title: Visual novel with custom stats and features in rpg maker mz

posts.author: BNTKids-Studios
posts.body:
Hello! I want to create a visual novel with custom stats in rpgmaker mz. However, I dont know really how to code properly to add custom message boxes, ui, and custom stats. I would think I need to download some plug-ins for these. I am just a humble basic coder with almost no coding history.l except a few mods on certain games.
Where can I look for resources and help on this?
My demo game requires the following:
Character busts
Message boxes
Closed world exploration (has limitations and bounderies)
Background full resolution comic book style imagery (done in a comic book style back to back image set that will appear sequentially wile characters are talking)
Interactivity with characters
Choices and decisions
A few monster and a single boss Battle.
Moves and elements
What my (demo) game does not require (but will require in the future)
Animations and special effects
High quality background music
Custom voices and voice acting.
Full fledged multiple storylines and stories to choose from
Saving data from each story such as map position, scene number, etc, and loading them.
Transferring each game's custom character attributes to a new game or a "Master" Game (ex, different main characters from different stories can be transfered over to the bigger game, to form an alliance to take down more powerful foes as a team!)
Online PVP battles, personal or coop. (Think I might have this one solved via a future developing plugin someone else is making)

posts.author: Magenta-Fantasies
posts.body:
Can you provide more specifics?
For example, what version of RPG Maker do you use? Offhand, I know of some plugins that could help with some of the things in your list, but they are all for RPG Maker MZ.
To start with, there are several plugins that can be used for character busts.
Galv’s MZ Message Busts
is one that is easy to use and free, but if I recall correctly, it has a lot of limitations.
MZ Message Busts
FEATURES This plugin can show a bust image based on the face image that was chosen in a ‘Show Text’ event command. Settings are included to choose where busts will display and plugin commands allow…
galvs-scripts.com
At one point, I tried it, but I stopped using it in favor of
NZ Prism’s Actor Pictures/Picture Message plugins.
These two plugins are also free, and you can create animated portraits using them! You have to have some amount of artistic skill to create each frame of the animations, but the plugin automatically animates them based on the parameters you give it. Initially, these plugins are not easy to set up, but once you find portrait positions and animation settings that work for you, you can copy and paste them for each animation you create. If you want to use this plugin, I can share the parameters I use with you.
RPG-Maker-MZ/ActorPictures/js/plugins/PictureMessage.js at master · nz-prism/RPG-Maker-MZ
Contains plugins/codes for RPG Maker MZ. Contribute to nz-prism/RPG-Maker-MZ development by creating an account on GitHub.
github.com
Also, r66r made an amazing edit to this plugin that makes the animations stop when the dialogue for the character speaking ends. For some reason, the plugin doesn’t do this on its own, which is very annoying.
MZ - How to edit this plugin so the animation stops when the dialogue stops?
Last year I discovered this fabulous plugin by nz_prism that lets you display AND animate full body character portraits! I’ve already created several cutscenes using it.  Here is the JavaScript, which is available for free...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
VisuStella has a bust plugin that looks promising, but it costs $15. I know it's a fairly popular plugin, but I've never used it myself.
Visual Novel Picture Busts VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
As for custom text boxes, I created a custom text box for my game, and I implement it using Galv's MZ message background.
MZ Message Background
FEATURES Display an image behind the message box instead of using the default window. You can change the image used during the game or disable it to return to using the default window. VERSION 1.0 …
galvs-scripts.com
It’s free and relatively easy to implement. You do need to have some artistic skills to create the custom text box itself, or hire someone to create it for you. It’s also possible to change the message background mid-game; I am strongly considering doing this in different story routes in my game.
You can see some of these in action on my social media. I just posted a video earlier this month that uses these plugins!
I also have some on YouTube as well:
If you click the button with the lines in the upper right corner of the YouTube video, you can view the playlist from there. This forum isn't letting me link directly to it.

posts.author: BNTKids-Studios
posts.body:
K, but about the custom stats, how do I get this implemented?
There are 8 stats in total I think on RPGMaker, but if I wanted to add more or change some, how would I go about doing this?
For example, if a character needed an additional grow-able stat based on level.
I am still deciding on a version and an exact base. I don't know if MZ or MV is going to be my final pick yet, still looking on plugin features for both.
I'm running into a snag with some different plugin features, and am trying to figure out the best of all worlds for one of the two bases (MV or MZ)
What I need is:
1. A plugin that allows bone movements for enemy characters, which fill face the player and the character portraits during gameplay.
- The plugin needs to adapt to allow custom animations, not just bone animations. For example, if the character were to, say, turn around and whip it's tail at the viewer, I'll need to figure out an easy way (no complex coding!) to make this happen and then transition back to the boned plugin images. (Say, when attack executes, display a different image, then, when attack ends, reshow the boned armature) The boned plugin will only allow for smooth idle animations for my game. I'm linking a good example for you to see.
Bone + Custom Animation YT
I've seen the MV dragonbones plugin, but I am not sure if I can do this with it or if there's a MZ equivalent with scaling and transformations.
2. A way to utilize and change elemental advantages flawlessly.
- Since I'm not familiar or have even downloaded rpgmaker MZ or MV, I don't know if elemental plugin is build into these programs. Further research is needed. I use RPGMaker XP currently and do this through other plugins and suites, but haven't seen a way to do this directly through the software. I need a total of 8 elements: Wind, Earth, Electricity, Water, Fire, Ice, Light, and Darkness.
3. Some assets I can use for my demo game. These assets are overworld purposed, like trees, grass, dirt path, etc, that are readily available for demonstration purposes only (by demonstration, I mean to show other people what I have to offer as a programmer, not the final product). I plan on using my own assets once I can pay the artist for the assets after my kickstarter is successful.
4. A little advice and show me hows here and there.
- Sometimes, video tutorials are not enough. They don't explain everything usually, only the basics. Sometimes, you are left with questions on how to make a function work the way YOU want it to work, that hasn't been shown. On youtube, you're limited to asking the tutorial guy a short question, and are at the mercy of if he answers at all. If he doesn't, you have three options: 1) to chug at it and program it in your game by trial and error (which, I am not good at, I don't have that skillset), OR, 2) find another way to implement said feature (again, don't have problem solving skills), OR 3) scrap said feature.
P.S.
Also, I forgot to note, I don't even have the assets yet to make this game. I am stuck between needing graphical assets and scripting/plugins. The two work hand-in-hand, and I need both to test things. How do I proceed?
P.P.S. I also forgot to mention, I don't have hundreds of dollars to try out different plugins, because you have to purchase said plugins before you can test or use them!

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body:
Okay, so, I'll try to say what I know here, in order.
If you're still looking for a way to get more parameters, Hakuen Studio has a plugin literally called "Custom Parameters"
Not entirely sure if an "easy" way for that animation stuff exists, sounds like it might be a "learn to do it or go without it" sort of situation.
The element thing is even more confusing. If you mean making characters have elemental weaknesses, that's the "element rate" parameter, which is part of actors, enemies, and states. If you want to
change them mid-battle
then something like the Visustella skills and states core might be what you're looking for?
uh, the RTP exists? everything you listed is in the RTP, I promise. Placeholder is the perfect place for a default asset
When asking a search engine for a tutorial, try to be specific. There are video tutorials for all sorts of things, and there are tutorials here on the forum, or on the Blog. If all else fails, then you could always come back to the forum and ask another question.
Once again, the RTP has a lot.
some plugins have sample projects, some are free, take a look around, and if you can't afford it, consider whether or not you really need the feature.
P.S. if you want to make a demo to show your offerings as a programmer, you may want to... make plugins yourself?
